Twitter () Facebook () IllinoisReview.com () Trump Kicks Zelenskyy, Ukraine Delegation Out of White House, Says he’s not Ready for Peace After Heated Oval Office Exchange () President Donald Trump meets with Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in the Oval Office at the White House in Washington, Feb. 28, 2025. (Jim Lo Scalzo/Pool/EPA-EFE/Shutterstock) By Illinois Review On Friday, after an unprecedented and heated exchange, President Donald Trump kicked Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy out of The White House, saying he “disrespected the United States of America in its cherished Oval Office.” In a post on his Truth Social account just minutes after the meeting, the President wrote, “We had a very meaningful meeting in the White House today. Much was learned that could never be understood without conversation under such fire and pressure. It’s amazing what comes out through emotion, and I have determined that President Zelenskyy is not ready for Peace if America is involved, because he feels our involvement gives him a big advantage in negotiations. I don’t want advantage, I want PEACE. He disrespected the United States of America in its cherished Oval Office. He can come back when he is ready for Peace.” The Ukrainian leader appeared combative and ungrateful, even shaking his head and rolling his eyes during discussions in the Oval Office with President Trump and Vice President Vance. “Do you think that it’s respectful to come to the Oval Office of the United States of America and attack the administration that is trying to prevent the destruction of your country?,” Vance asked Zelenskyy. “You don’t have the cards right now. With us, you start having cards ... You’re gambling with the lives of millions of people! You’re gambling with World War III!,” the President told Zelenskyy. subject: I'm suing the DOJ
body:
| | | Together we can hold the DOJ and the deep state accountable.
---
| | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=fd84f9a89c7e4c2f8003a78e86339235&_e=psR-18fL-NS32PXQjq0BBY2e06EZbQlGbWXMAFGGN_KTfzmamo1U7qCFSMcPkLF5bwk6-smpkqNQb9mG_vLJNkEEnIJkuIGRmODN6wFvQ1z3epLEZDeEk_GszKuTbeYCcHA3FQyfvXcEjQk0mZMnkMWeJCFDzvrVe9E2OJszmj0ZT283_hzirnpKXQouiDZX_utAeIb-6lX6-O5TApRmHD_bzeITReEhUPIxAV-VBWnsKKONvU0Y9bu78TZMnY4HWwM8qFKpdfpv-dXh5ipd5qNYoPSGB4hZ0CImSD9t1HCxQV3JFcilc2GlxPuDaf63YBsa5NuYflSNTkAfUMycZGjsBpWpEF8taxlxNf3KtzBFoxTAgqjf3FuolZWdyVDD4ympumXCBefYE8wZ8v718vf9UrRSxLKBJZB7R-nehkg%3D)
---
Three years ago, The DOJ threatened me and other journalists with _**criminal charges** _in connection to the explosive Ashley Biden Diary. Heavily armed FBI agents burst into my residence and ransacked my personal property. They raided two of my fellow journalists homes too. To this day, they refuse to show me the evidence they used as probable cause to conduct a heavily armed raid of my residence. From day one my lawyers and I knew the case against me was purely political – and it succeeded in suppressing politically damaging contents of the Ashley Biden diary. As soon as Attorney General Pam Bondi was sworn in, the charges against me were suddenly dropped. But do you really believe that the corrupt actors at the DOJ that sent armed FBI agents with battering rams to my house are suddenly going to see the light? Remember, this this the same weaponized DOJ that: **\---> Investigated moms who spoke at school board meetings **** **** \---> Turned a blind eye to our reporting of corruption and abuse in federal prisons**** ****\---> Attempted to censor our reporting of voter registration irregularities in Georgia.** Now they’re playing possum – some of them might think they can just wait Trump out like they did last term. As a journalist, I refuse to let them hide in the shadows. We must expose them now. That’s why I’m laying the groundwork for our lawsuit against the DOJ. We need to expose the ringleaders. We need to uncover all internal communications. The career corrupt actors who’ve been weaponizing the DOJ for years aren’t going to go down without a fight. We’ve seen their playbook before. During the first Trump administration, my reporting caught DOJ officials plotting to “resist from the inside” because “they couldn’t really get fired”. But with your help, we can expose these bad actors and hold them accountable. When we win, It's going to be a win for the first amendment. And if we can prove that they broke the law, you can be sure that we will push for criminal prosecutions. My friend, this political witch hunt against me has already cost me hundreds of thousands of dollars. But we’re not going to cure the rot at the Department of Justice by nibbling the edges. We need to go in there with our own battering ram. My lawsuit will do just that. [That’s why I’m calling on you to join me in this crucial effort by making a $25 tax-deductible contribution to the Citizen Journalism Foundation today.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=fd84f9a89c7e4c2f8003a78e86339235&_e=psR-18fL-NS32PXQjq0BBY2e06EZbQlGbWXMAFGGN_KTfzmamo1U7qCFSMcPkLF5bwk6-smpkqNQb9mG_vLJNkEEnIJkuIGRmODN6wFvQ1z3epLEZDeEk_GszKuTbeYCcHA3FQyfvXcEjQk0mZMnkMWeJCFDzvrVe9E2OJszmj0ZT283_hzirnpKXQouiDZX_utAeIb-6lX6-O5TApRmHD_bzeITReEhUPIxAV-VBWnsKKONvU0Y9bu78TZMnY4HVUk2dixeNR_ISwhSFu3HijWq9_BnLtcTTmxXUrC98_cVqCUubYDqG8PNzd0FV2wc453KQJXLPYVCWCcjav_OhNd29ppxKzO62Q-M-h2oIXvj20tl0dfcBS-9S66VF3BVldf7WP9m3JciebTLR2f8ZPL-SbuAO0M4OeH92McBArQ%3D) Together we can hold the DOJ and the deep state accountable.

Thank you for your support,

Friends... it has been a very long February, ironic that it’s the shortest month of the year, but with the daily onslaught we’re seeing, it’s hard to keep focus on what really matters right now.

Gwen and I met earlier this week, and I gave her an update of our goals and priorities for the first 4 months of this year, and right now, our focus at home is on the coming Spring elections.

I know you’re tired. I’m tired and we’ve only been here for less than 3 months, but what we need to do right now is present a united front and be prepared for whatever else that is coming our way – that means driving a first class GOTV effort to help us hold the WI State Supreme Court.

Your grassroots contribution right now helps push out our GOTV message for the early April elections and we have until midnight to close the gap on our February fundraising goal.

We’re so close! We need 52 grassroots donations of $24 or more in the next few hours. If you can, please chip in to keep our numbers on track.

Donate: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gwenfeb20252?refcode=0228

I’m updating the plan and our team hourly. I know Gwen would be grateful to see your name on the next list I send her.

Thank you in advance!

Chris Trull, Gwen Moore for Congress
Proudly representing Wisconsin's 4th Congressional District
Proud Co-Leader of the Violence Against Women Act
100% Pro-Choice
100% Democracy Defender

name: Kimberly Bretches
subject: Life behind bars could be his “reward.”
body:
| | | The same city that gave Chance this award is trying to put him in prison for life for doing his job.
---
| |
---
Dear Peter, That's me and my husband, Officer Chance Bretches in the picture I've sent you...
---
[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=08d38559dd0f48c8a1b512779e812ae1&_e=ILhkhdLQBtQlp2WBst-gkwrlPsu4nh1uU7exhsRam1XpO06vHruhA3NA6VoH3UeO12dVX7iI7HuYF1H3fnZkfPi-yY1lGAvpfyXIuiRYCAu8Lmyop2shjrNJ2UKrDiYlX7-Gks1Jqs0eB3HN0GVSx9eAU0RTcPYlqdjgcsacB7J9HDCR9VJjD5bw3HyR1T26xg3JAXGiEdwKpXpMTa4fy078UPCJEoGfNpb7gTlDw-vlhqu9agurCVO4eQOQpmZn0YWg1gF8RtSNN2fVql4rN2sqisSRiWEMNO7GRqKLTkK8sGRWwAhgI1npoet7OY2txH45Lp6beqVpj75HDCi3aFo9b89mBsKeZ2I68oXviRMTlP7Moe4yH49SHfhctmNE8Y1sVdnczCgBNUSggCa-Sw%3D%3D)
---
...a picture we took on the day Chance received the Lifesaving Medal With Valor for rescuing a driver from a crashed car that had caught on fire. This photo used to be one of my favorites. Now looking at it makes me cry. Because in July, the same city that gave Chance this award... ...will try to lock him up for life for doing his job. I should explain. For nearly 13 years, Chance has been a decorated police officer with the Austin, Texas Police Department. But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down. You probably remember what it was like in our country after George Floyd. Violent, fiery anti-police protests were sweeping through cities. Every step of the way, they were cheered on by radical politicians, Soros-funded prosecutors, and the Mainstream Media who lied to us and said, with a straight face, that these riots were "mostly peaceful." It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off. And my husband made it home safe and sound. What I didn’t know then was that this nightmare wasn't over for us. Far from it. Unknown to Chance and the other officers on duty that night, an anti-police protestor was hit by one of my husband's non-lethal rounds. They claimed they were injured and lost part of their finger. And for that... ...the county prosecutor charged my husband with "aggravated assault by a public servant" -- a charge punishable by life in prison. This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free... ...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters. What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-cop crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make cops pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. He's served on mission trips -- planting churches, planning vacation Bible schools, and sharing the Gospel. And he's done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record. Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars and could be his "reward." Even if my husband's good name is cleared there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills. Thankfully, by God's grace, there is one group who has stepped up to help us -- the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know that their record has made them a policemen's best friend. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. LELDF hires the best attorneys and secures expert witnesses who will testify to the truth -- without being influenced by political paybacks. And now they've agreed to help Chance. ## Prom Date Donates Kidney 35 Years Later
A Colorado woman who attended prom with a Pennsylvania doctor 35 years ago has [donated a kidney to help save his life](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kLuyniAURp8GOxzO9gIWFGns_rQpnS1slATBAaLj22fMA5z6u8ya9euzfNAHH7efeJB2m1uqSwsIGLgADmqx6MOz9I3Vjgioa0h_yV5I2Y9KNrsG6UzXkRkH0cnJKTNIuSrljIJpMGvfeP2-CQAFAsZBtnZFsj3JSU1fUg6K9YKsrym3v5OPdScXnnRRbk06mqD3Ws_Cuh8MZgbzfd8trgbkmzKYQzIYeKS7MJh3zNmX9W_eGMwmhZTRJn6nAyO3KWKlwv94G-nhNfGCF_GTYixPuDB65G-vG_hDmAtHVynzutPDb4r1XZw5HbymjepOmcHcZG3P24fgyyhZL7YDffiPXb9TeWn4FwAA__9Ecnrt). Elena Hershey learned through mutual friends that Dr. Shawn Moyer needed a third kidney transplant after his previous transplants failed. Though not a direct biological match for Moyer, Hershey donated her kidney through a "paired exchange" program last summer, which guaranteed him priority for a transplant within six months. Moyer received the call on Feb. 14 that a kidney was available, with the surgery successfully completed last Thursday. "It's just a remarkable thing for somebody to do," said Moyer of Hershey's life-saving gift, while Hershey described her decision simply: "A few weeks of having to rest and a few days of discomfort to extend someone's life? It really is kind of a no-brainer.” [Watch a report here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8z7FugzAQxvGnsbeg4zCcGTxUqlCXdGiHqhMy8RlcOXEEDpQ-fUUfoOv3ST_p_3HuzzbEcBtf7ZWNH32ffeoRsD4BnlD3zoa490o645mRK8mmJAVEqtEkJ8MOlGcLVkHbcDv4oSxbVBqgsUTlIIM5NEDUCNjUVLjBslNMrW5LoloLBexCTnPxlcItT-zjnlaei0u6ymimnO-LqJ4EdgK7bduKPT3yY-DjPxabL5OoulVUzy9vy_dYp_ef7lPOxt23EGNYGhIKxqsN8Y_M_2WuBn8DAAD__1spVag).
## 94-Year-Old Serenades Wife Nightly for 50 Years
Don Barnett, 94, serenades his 93-year-old wife, Marilyn, [every night before bed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kLGunDAQRb_GdLPyjg0DBUWUJ6QU-9qUyDBjcOLFT7aziL-PNh-Q7kpXulfn_HzMDxdiOLZP95TRb36uPs2osQWNgP3MLsRrtg2PXgTFNDLeyWoi2_XU7CPb1QwdGW_0QIyk27XVK-lhIe94oSaM7zWN2KPGrqUbL07YCg39cCdqe2W1cKgp336lcNRdfLzSS_JtTc8mjnutX0WZbwonhdN5nrd1KYec5d0rnN5R4fR0OQdhOMTleAEBy-pYCtRdikBML1lC5gKlhhihuAsCcAJ5Sb7gCNteoe45_dl2KOnY3ndm8tVtynx8_3yA1nDXzi09K-xiOH7_YGU-yA62NdhRk0f-OkOMoXSkrN6eLsR_CPV_Wl8j_g0AAP___RF66Q)—a tradition they've maintained for about 50 years. This ritual began when Don discovered that singing to Marilyn pleased her and helped them both feel calm, especially after disagreements. Their son, Doug, noted that they never miss this nightly serenade, even continuing it when Marilyn was hospitalized after breaking her hip. Don believes that singing to his spouse shows a deeper level of care than a simple "Goodnight, honey." See a [photo of the couple here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kMGKqzAUQL8m7q7Ya0x0kcWDPuHBazctzFKiuWpmUlOSjJL5-qHzAbM_HA7n7TJctHV2W676QWpe5iHNfsAKG6gQsB2Mti4PvDBqJkKqC1InySspuWhlsaqpJlHLWU6m4xrrVowjSmzHiQtC2YjCqpetQmyxQtHI0oyaDCfZtd1JyqZlvCJjkw_lu7dbWml22e8Uysk_CqfWlJ6R1X8Y9gz74zjK-LltOX7krxfBsF-8N7DRERn2jehODPuLDsGSgd4HuJIOLoOEM03aUIT7SpHgfnj473cabTARbsk6Bzed4R-cPfzdKWS42mVNRVDmeVjnbBSS8Wp5aOt-2tJvv3aF3wEAAP__wllvAw).
## Miniature Donkey Trains to Bring Comfort
Seamus, [a 5-month-old miniature donkey](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kDFv8yAQQH8N3myRC_jIwPAt3vKtHa3Dd8S0BCKbxsq_r1p17viW96T3dp2vlHIqt_90Fx9vcW6xzqDB9hp6cDNTyq_ZdOyjCMi5E39CoxHN6LBbvXVB20tYrAaNCJEij2OIACY4cs52yX_bNIADDaPFgQMJG8GLu5wQrVNGC6dWt-G9ptJWiflVn7INS7132a-tPXZ1_qdgUjAdxzEsYRkWUjAVOXYF00KF-Jdj_SycqXCfKWzEdVMwhVromfZGfalbW3uu5UNe_WlAM4I9m27z_DhSzmkfURl9u1PKP_n215Knh68AAAD__33sZJs) in Canada, is being trained as a therapy animal to provide comfort to those in need. The donkey follows a daily routine that includes indoor visits to acclimate him to human environments before he eventually joins two horses and a mule. Seamus' owner, Dana Blackmore, plans to build a barn on newly acquired farmland where she hope to establish a formal therapy animal program. _"He's going to have a role to play in bringing some smiles,"_ Blackmore said. But I also knew that New York’s working families deserved a champion – and I would do it all a thousand times over.

But I’m nowhere near done fighting for the voiceless and vulnerable, _especially_ now that these powerful and corrupt actors have shown their true colors. These men think they can rattle me and scare me off my path, but the truth is, they have only reaffirmed why I went into this work in the first place.

Dear Team,
This is Gay Valimont, FL-1 candidate for the upcoming special election on April 1st.
We only have 5 weeks to hit our goals and get into office, and Musk is accelerating efforts to stall us.
Notably, Musk's collaboration with key political figures, such as Stephen and Katie Miller, has facilitated the rapid execution of these initiatives. Stephen Miller, serving as the White House deputy chief of staff for policy, manages daily governmental responsibilities, while Katie Miller oversees communications at DOGE. Their combined efforts have expedited significant federal restructuring, aligning with their objectives, at the expense of the livelihoods of hundreds of workers.
Elon’s staffers are a bunch of rag-tag yes-men that just follow his order. They lack the necessary understanding to handle critical government information, yet they are replacing actual workers. This raises concerns about potential security vulnerabilities and the safeguarding of our nation's secrets.
Moreover, Musk's recent appearance at the Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC) underscores the growing intertwining of technological influence with political agendas. His presence at such events highlights the need for vigilant oversight to ensure that personal interests do not overshadow public welfare.
My main goal is simple: YOU. Musk cannot fight the voices of Americans, and it is the only way for us to win this election.

| | | | Team,
Today you've likely already received a few, perhaps many, emails from PACs, candidates, and elected officials talking about the importance of tonight's end of month deadline.
Unless you received an email from one of the two other Democrats running in special elections for Congress right now, no political email in your inbox is more important than the one you are reading right now.
Yes. Ours trumps all of them. The stakes couldn't be higher. Dems breaking the Republican trifecta (House, Senate, Exec) and retaking control - is contingent on Democrat Josh Weil winning the FL-06 Special in a month and two days.
This is our true last end of month deadline before our April 1st election (technically we have March 31st but that is the literal night before the election - tonight matters most).
As I write to you, we are behind on the fundraising goal we set out earlier this week. To be specific, $53,212, off from where we need to be tonight to stay on track for the smallest budget that our team could win this with.

Peter, President Zelenskyy met with President Trump in the Oval Office today.
What followed was a spectacle that only Russia could enjoy.
Trump and Vance berated Zelenskyy for having the gall to defend his country. They demanded him to bend the knee and kiss the ring. They parroted Kremlin talking points. Trump even expressed camaraderie with Putin, that they went through the Russia “hoax” together.

Just because Trump has bowed to Putin does not mean the American people will. I know there are millions of Americans who will continue to stand with Ukraine — and that is going to be essential as we work against Trump over the next four years.
VoteVets will work relentlessly to promote leaders who will oppose Trump, like my brother Eugene. Every dollar we raise today will go towards electing strong leaders from Military and National Security backgrounds to positions of power.

Did you know that 50,000 of your brain cells die every day?

**If you 're over 50 and you forget a name, misplace your keys, or just feel foggy all the time -- that means your brain cells are dying off even faster.**

I was shocked to learn this myself.

It turns out... _Stanford University_ neuroscientists identified a nasty "cell invader." It attacks cells in the memory center of your brain - the hippocampus - causing your brain to shrink.

Thankfully there's something you can do from home to clear it out.

The 17,789 Americans who've tried this report improved memory and boosted brain power.

Dr. Rivers has spent the better part of his career studying senescent cells, which is the technical term for the "brain invaders" that can shrivel up your brain's memory center.

He's considered one of New York City's top brain doctors, and after he showed his 8-second daily ritual to his parents & in-laws...

They could only describe the sharp mental clarity they felt as "a cloud being lifted." That's why so many seniors have called it a "memory miracle" or a "total game changer."

This is a totally new way to address the root cause of brain fog, fuzzy thinking, and depleted brain power...and you can do it from home without any pills or exercise.

(The secret is in your ears.)

| | **_Meet Kat_** Kat Cammack is currently serving her third term representing the FREE state of Florida in the People’s House as FL-03 Congresswoman. And her road from the small cattle ranch she grew up on to the halls of Congress in our nation’s capital has been far from ordinary. A third generation commercial sandblaster, Kat originally aspired to take over her family’s business and continue the rural, rodeo lifestyle she had grown so accustomed to. That was until a failed Obama-era housing policy caused Kat’s family to lose their ranch, leaving her and her mother homeless. They lived in their car and bounced from cheap motel to cheap motel just to keep a roof over their heads. But overcoming these hardships moulded Kat into the gritty and unapologetic leader she is today. After her family’s livelihood was destroyed by big government, she made it her life mission to deliver federal reform in the DC Swamp for the American people. So she packed her belongings and moved to Florida’s 3rd Congressional District – where she would serve as a Deputy Chief of Staff for nearly a decade before running for Congress herself. After emerging victorious in a brutal, 10-way GOP primary contest, the people of FL-03 elected Kat to serve them in the People’s House in November of 2020. Throughout her journey from homelessness to the House of Representatives, Kat Cammack has shown unwavering and unapologetic grit in her fight for the American people. And she has no plans of backing down until we truly have a government for the people, by the people once again here in the United States. When she’s not going toe-to-toe with the Washington Swamp, Kat enjoys spending time with her loving husband Matt – who serves as a firefighter and SWAT Medic with the Gainesville Fire Rescue. In the little spare time that they have, you can find Kat and Matt fishing, skeet shooting, or watching Gators football. They are incredibly proud to call north central Florida’s “Gator Nation” home. Go Gators, and let’s keep Florida the most FREE state in the union!

Help STOP Elon Musk’s Attacks on the Environment >> https://links.messages.lcv. DEVELOPING — Elon Musk and his “Department of Government Efficiency” (DOGE) have
seized access to the Environmental Protection Agency’s (EPA) contracts and
payments system, and they aim to slash climate and environmental justice
programs — AND just this week, Trump and EPA Administrator Zeldin said they want
to cut EPA by 65 percent with the help of Musk and his DOGE cronies. This comes as Musk and his team have targeted environmental agencies with
unprecedented layoffs and halt-work orders. Musk has threatened to terminate more than 1,100 employees at the EPA and has
put the ENTIRE Office of Environmental Justice and anyone with environmental
justice in their job descriptions on administrative leave. Without staff or budget to carry out their mission — and with Musk controlling
the payments systems — environmental agencies will be prevented from enforcing our most fundamental
environmental laws,including keeping communities safe from pollution and cleaning up after
environmental disasters. Peter, we need your help to STOPElon Musk’s illegal attacks on agencies that make our communities healthy,
protect us from natural disasters, and combat the climate crisis. Help us fight back against Musk’s illegal power grab. Please — renew your membership today. The New York Timesis now reporting that “grants to help diversity, climate programs, and
environmental-justice efforts” are set for permanent cuts. The DOGE freeze is having far-reaching impacts in communities across the
country.In Jackson, Mississippi, a storm shelter renovation project that would protect
low-income residents from hurricanes and extreme heat is on hold. In Ovando,
Montana, efforts to guard forests against severe drought and damaging wildfires
have been halted. Not even our schools are safe.In St. Louis, Missouri, the Ritenour School District can no longer take delivery
of electric school buses. Despite two court orders telling the Trump
administration to end the freeze, the Ritenour School District still can’t
access their funding and have been left scrambling to buy cheaper,
heavy-polluting buses instead of hiring teachers. Meanwhile, as federal grantees like these wait in limbo around the country,
Musk’s companies have been awarded tens of millions of dollars in new federal
contracts. Peter, we need your help to STOPElon Musk’s illegal attacks on the EPA and other key agencies. Public pressure
has put the Trump administration on the back foot before. Our collective voices
hold power. Holding Elon Musk accountable will take ALL of us pitching in. Renew your LCV membership before the midnight deadline, Peter — $5 is all it takes right now >> https://links.messages.lcv. Friend,

I know that the past few weeks have been filled with a lot of chaos, confusion, and policies from the Trump administration that directly harm the American people.
That's why, in this time of great uncertainty, I wanted to reach out and personally share my steadfast promise with you: **I will always prioritize making life better for _you_ and _your_ family – not billionaires and the wealthy few. **
That means lowering the costs of prescription drugs so no one has to choose between food and medicine. It means bringing down _everyday_ costs and making it easier for families to make ends meet. It means fighting with everything I have to protect our most fundamental freedoms. And it means staying ready to hold the line against all of the dangerous actions that are undoubtedly still to come from this administration.

| | | | | **Lamont McClure for Violent Illegal Immigrants**
Yesterday, Northampton County Executive Lamont McClure announced his intention to challenge me in the next race for Congress. You may remember Lamont McClure for siding with violent illegal immigrant criminals instead of fully cooperating with ICE and law enforcement.
---
| [READ MORE HERE](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=bcc89ed528&e=5ccada9200)
---
| This comes following two terms marked by embarrassing failures, public spectacles, and a steadfast refusal to fully cooperate with law enforcement. Now, Lamont McClure has decided that he’s the right person to represent the Greater Lehigh Valley in Congress.
Lamont McClure has spent recent weeks trying to justify his policy of rejecting ICE detainers - allowing predators and abusers to walk free from prison. He has been repeatedly [condemned](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=ecb0bd3f08&e=5ccada9200) by authorities at ICE for this dangerous policy.
With nearly two years until the election, McClure has decided that he needs as much time as possible to try and redefine his record of gross mismanagement and callous disregard for public safety. After weeks of trying to explain away his decision to reject ICE detainers and let illegal immigrant criminals walk free from prison, McClure has decided to take his America Last agenda to Congress.
McClure has also repeatedly failed at one of the most basic jobs of county government — botching three of the last five elections in Northampton County. McClure has repeatedly proven that he can't run an election without disenfranchising voters and landing Northampton County in the headlines for all the wrong reasons.
You can see his repeated election failures here: [2019](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=68eef0154d&e=5ccada9200), [2023](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=4a731267b1&e=5ccada9200), [2024](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=4df00ebc96&e=5ccada9200) Banana Factory.
While McClure spends the next 21 months campaigning, I will be doing my job and following through on the commitments I made to the people of the Greater Lehigh Valley, including securing the border, fighting for working families, and keeping our communities safe.

_Legislative Session Reaches Halfway Point_ **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102978069/530874060/-1733415516?s=46&t=Dj7-Y210GYDWXG21xFaxCQ&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZjZkYmJmNS0yNmY2LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTkzYjUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IIuXw4CnWfbv8l2tzHARf-wmQEpBMNwPayhwlIWZvzA=&emci=dafbe14d-25f6-ef11-90cb-0022482a93b5&emdi=3f6dbbf5-26f6-ef11-90cb-0022482a93b5&ceid=4925535)**[Share INDems](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102978070/530874061/-1733415516?s=46&t=Dj7-Y210GYDWXG21xFaxCQ&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZjZkYmJmNS0yNmY2LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTkzYjUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IIuXw4CnWfbv8l2tzHARf-wmQEpBMNwPayhwlIWZvzA=&emci=dafbe14d-25f6-ef11-90cb-0022482a93b5&emdi=3f6dbbf5-26f6-ef11-90cb-0022482a93b5&ceid=4925535) We have reached the halfway point of the legislative session in Indiana. All bills filed this year were required to pass their house of origin by the end of last week. There is some good news and bad news from this first major deadline. The good news is that we defeated bills to criminalize homelessness, institute closed primaries, and all attempts to criminalize abortion in Indiana. clean_body: | Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party's weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. = ** Legislative Session Reaches Halfway Point We have reached the halfway point of the legislative session in Indiana. All bills filed this year were required to pass their house of origin by the end of last week. There is some good news and bad news from this first major deadline. The good news is that we defeated bills to criminalize homelessness, institute closed primaries, and all attempts to criminalize abortion in Indiana. While the language could return in other bills, this is a psoitive first step. However, many dangerous pieces of legislation moved forward. These include the budget which gives huge handouts to millionaires to send their kids to private schools while barely giving our public schools a raise. Also, a Senate-passed bill would cap the number of enrollees allowed on HiP 2.0 at 500,000 per year. This means that over 200,000 Hoosiers stand to lose their coverage. Every Democrat In Congress Votes Against Dangerous Republican Reconciliation Proposal The Republican-controlled Congress passed its first step toward a new federal budget that would slash SNAP benefits, Medicaid benefits, and healthcare coverage for hundreds of thousands of Hoosiers. Every Democrat in Congress voted against this proposal, including Indiana’s own Rep. Frank Mrvan and Rep. Andre Carson. However, every Indiana Republican voted for this bill which adds $4 trillion to our federal deficit while lowering taxes for the wealthiest 1% of households across the country. Democrats will always stand for working people against these austerity measures. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. US Rep. Frank Mrvan of Northwest Indiana will be holding a virtual town forum meeting this upcoming week on March 5. Rep. Mrvan knows his constituents deserve to hear from him on the important work being done in Washington, and the cuts coming down on Hoosier families from this administration. Get Involved! Opportunities After the Election As we move past the 2024 Election, it is imperative that we unite together to create a better future for our state. One of the best ways to do that is to help us rebuild our party and grow in the coming months and years. Make Your Voice Heard! | Team,

There is a lot of talk about how Donald Trump’s policies are going to hit rural Americans and lower-income households harder than most. And for a lot of folks, they assume that most of them are Trump supporters, so they write them off.

But to do so would be a huge mistake, and ensure Democrats remain in the minority for generations to come.

What rural people and the working class need from Democrats right now is more than just a handful of policies that sound nice but fail to address the ins and outs of their daily lives.

I myself live in a rural town in Nevada, and Will who serves on [National Ground Game’s board](https://rpprrv.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEzMjg2NTcsXCJsXCI6MTQ3NjIyMTIwMTU1Nzc2NjMzLFwiclwiOjE0NzYyMjE0NTM5MTg1NTU0OX0iLCJzIjoiN2I5ZTdjMmM2YmJjNDZjNCJ9) is a farmer from rural Missouri. (Will is both a farmer and a seasoned political hand—he is known on social media as “Your Favorite Rural Campaign and Elections Expert.”)

Winning back working class and rural voters to the Democratic Party isn’t just abstract political strategy to us— _it’s about improving the lives of our neighbors, friends, and the**99% of Americans who are getting screwed daily** by the billionaire class and massive corporations._

From massive tax cuts that benefit the already-wealthy, to crippling tariffs that would devastate entire communities living paycheck to paycheck: **the Trump agenda is hostile to the working class.**

But in our conversations, we win when we tell voters what we are fighting FOR: fully funded public education, better pay for teachers, affordable child care, quality jobs with dignity, and healthcare for all. **

The time to act to win folks over and strengthen this core mission is now.** If we work to organize right now, and work to win these upcoming special elections, we can peel back Trump’s grip on power in Congress.

clean_body: | | The way forward is to offer a better plan on economic issues, not simply be anti-Trump. | | | | | Team, There is a lot of talk about how Donald Trump’s policies are going to hit rural Americans and lower-income households harder than most. And for a lot of folks, they assume that most of them are Trump supporters, so they write them off. But to do so would be a huge mistake, and ensure Democrats remain in the minority for generations to come. What rural people and the working class need from Democrats right now is more than just a handful of policies that sound nice but fail to address the ins and outs of their daily lives. I myself live in a rural town in Nevada, and Will who serves on is a farmer from rural Missouri. (Will is both a farmer and a seasoned political hand—he is known on social media as “Your Favorite Rural Campaign and Elections Expert.”) Winning back working class and rural voters to the Democratic Party isn’t just abstract political strategy to us— it’s about improving the lives of our neighbors, friends, and the99% of Americans who are getting screwed daily by the billionaire class and massive corporations. From massive tax cuts that benefit the already-wealthy, to crippling tariffs that would devastate entire communities living paycheck to paycheck: the Trump agenda is hostile to the working class. But in our conversations, we win when we tell voters what we are fighting FOR: fully funded public education, better pay for teachers, affordable child care, quality jobs with dignity, and healthcare for all. The time to act to win folks over and strengthen this core mission is now. If we work to organize right now, and work to win these upcoming special elections, we can peel back Trump’s grip on power in Congress. | | | | | Let’s make sure that this critical moment to secure a better life for most Americans doesn’t slip away. Stand with us — and together, we can fight for a future where power remains in the hands of the people, not in the hands of one man who wants to rule like a king. It's our 400th episode of the Sean Spicer Show and we have a very special show for you. Jordan Karem was the Director of Oval Office Operations during Trump 45 and Derek Lyons was former White House Staff Secretary. Jordan was the first person to see President Trump in the morning and the last one to see him before bed. he can attest to the rigorous, energized and demanding pace the president keeps at all times. Even aboard Air Force One, where the president has a state of the art bed for long flights, the president never used it. Will Scharf now has Derek Lyons job and has gained notoriety for explaining the executive orders President Trump is about to sign. As White House Staff Secretary, Derek notes that President Trump wants to hear what what people think and values opinions when decisions are being made. Both have heartwarming memories of President Trump and expressed how empathetic he really is. In this episode, Derek and Jordan, take us inside the White House during the first Trump administration for a behind the scenes look at what it's like to work for President Trump.

"Would you want to pay somebody to do a job and they don't show up to work?!" she continued. "I don't think so! I could name five things, in about 5 minutes of me coming into the office everyday. If you struggle to do that for a week, there is no excuse for that! You better be able to answer it!"
Another reporter asked if Habba could offer clarification for workers who are "confused."
Habba snapped, "I'm not sure why you're confused or why it's so hard to answer what five things you've done in the past week!"

"Zelensky said that he will wear one after the war is finished. "Maybe something like yours, or maybe something better, we will see,... maybe something cheaper," Zelensky continued, quickly looking away for the next question somewhere else in the room.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Elon should get off Twitter and face serious questions from real people
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2494%2E4032634%2E3GtQCj)
---
If Elon Musk wants to kill off the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, he should be able to explain why to the American people. **That’s why I had invited him to Congress this week to speak at a hearing about the CFPB. I wanted to hear him answer our questions about how dismantling the agency will “eliminate fraud” and help working people.** No surprise, he did not show up. He doesn't have the guts to defend his actions to Congress. Why? Because he knows he's giving free reign to Wall Street to scam you. What a coward. He says that he’s for maximum transparency. If that’s so, he should get off Twitter and face real questions from serious people. He says he’s for getting rid of fraud. If that’s so, he wouldn’t be eliminating the agency that mitigates fraud for working people. He and Trump say they’re for lowering costs for working people. If that’s so, they wouldn’t be going after the only financial regulator that is dedicated solely to protecting Americans wallets and that has returned $21 billion dollars to working people who were scammed. His actions contradict his words. He can’t defend what he’s done. So we have to keep telling the real story of the CFPB. Meanwhile, I realize Elon Musk has a huge ego and doesn’t think he has to answer to anybody, but the thing is, the law applies to him, just like it applies to everybody else. And the law is that Congress created the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau — and only Congress could actually get rid of it. Not a president acting alone, and not a billionaire acting alone. So here’s what we’re doing about this: In the courts, we’re calling for the law to be enforced. In Congress, we’re working to get people like Co-President Elon Musk, OMB Director Russ Vought, and the new CFPB director nominee on record about where their loyalties are. And all over America, at protests, town halls, local organizing events, on the news, and in newsfeeds, we’re raising our voices — growing strong, public opposition against what they’re doing. We can’t let the field open to just Elon Musk and a handful of his hacker minions. Your voices and your stories matter. It was public opposition that saved health care in 2018, and we can grow a strong grassroots movement again to stop them. I need you to stay in this fight. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: The betrayal of America

body:
[1]Powered By People

I just watched the oval office meeting between President Trump, Vice
President Vance and President Zelensky of Ukraine. I'm sure you've read
about it by now or seen video clips of Vance and Trump attempting to
humiliate Zelensky in front of the global press.

One thing is clear: Trump and JD are thugs. And this ambush of Zelensky at
the White House will do deep damage to Ukraine, to our allies and to the
U.S.

Openly ridiculing and demeaning a man who has kept his country alive for
three years against all the odds is a national embarrassment and runs
counter to our own security interests. But they could care less that
Ukraine was invaded by Russia — the second biggest military power on the
planet — led by a ruthless dictator willing to sacrifice soldiers and
civilians by the hundreds of thousands. Trump and JD were trying to look
tough even though it’s clear that Zelensky was the strongest man in the
room. The guy who was supposed to lose to Russia in a matter of hours or
days is still there, fighting. As are the brave Ukrainian soldiers on the
front line.

We help Ukraine because it’s the right thing to do for a fellow democracy
that is suffering a brutal invasion AND because if Ukraine were to fall,
the next fight would be on the front lines of our NATO allies and our
military would be treaty-bound to join the war. In other words, Ukraine is
shouldering the total cost in terms of the fighting, the lives forever
damaged and the lives lost so that we and our European allies don’t have
to.

Trump and Vance are not only abandoning Ukraine. They are abandoning the
security of our country. Today they made it much more likely that our
service members will be fighting again in Europe, 80 years after countless
brave Americans helped liberate the continent and make it safe for
democracy.

Shameful.

It's up to us to engage members of Congress -- Democrats and Republicans
-- and push them to fight back against Trump's disastrous foreign policy.
It's up to us to engage voters across Texas who will decide the balance of
power in the U.S. Congress after 2026. It's up to us to do the work to
save our country at this moment of truth.

[ https://www.mobilize.us/poweredxpeople/event/664441/?source=ema20250228-240000&utm_source=email ]I hope you will join us by signing up to volunteer today.

Thank you,

Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to act. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1001&akid=240000%2E444211%2E386r4X

name: Tobias Read
subject: surprised and thankful
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250228em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250228em]
Hi folks, it’s Oregon Secretary of State Tobias Read. It’s late on a Friday, so I’ll be brief.
Earlier this week, I set a goal of raising $5,000 before the end of February — and I’ve been so surprised and thankful for the support I’ve received since then.
We have already raised $4,430 of the $5,000 we need and have just a few hours left.
I am encouraged that so many people are fired up to stand up against President Trump’s assaults on democracy.
My office is committed to integrity, accountability, and competence, and it’s clear that so many of you are, too.
So, I wanted to reach out one more time before tonight’s deadline and ask you to make a contribution that will help us reach the finish line.
Please, make a donation of $20 – or whatever amount you can – before midnight tonight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250228em]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250228em]
Thank you for your help.
Tobias Read
P.S. Don’t forget! The Oregon Political Tax Credit allows you to donate $50 (if you file single) or $100 (if you file joint) to a candidate, PAC, or party, which will be fully credited back as a rebate — so it’s free to donate! For more information, click here. [https://www.oregon.gov/omd/ONG/Documents/SMFS/Personal%20Financial%20Counselor/Political-Tax-Credit.pdf?]

subject: Why chemistry?
body:

Unsubscribe

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssf1xg&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dem4cfbrsibp09gn4x2jvs4itnzb9m6d4cbjd01kmbh3mnxlxrjrkp1cxsoanomum5rvmxfh7x8u56ngf9cqy93ls2o4kqymmmq4yizf47f4j7zudaufn65sgseq7nyh22tkprwbw956ey9w9dtj&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssf1xg&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssf1xg&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssf1xg&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssf1xg&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dem4cfbrsibp09gn4x2jvs4ickc5t24xizjps6rxt2sk4ynjnzwy4iu8dlspdjbw62thn59cm92ftm1byqgm8hpc4l53hojm718ltqarszgz85obfxyrk5dcvq2na56rqo7n5i7brmgimnoh7rjy&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssf1xg&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssf1xg&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| Hi Peter,

I’m Joe Kerr, a second-generation firefighter and labor leader. For three decades, I’ve run headfirst toward the problem—whether inside burning buildings or in the halls of the State Assembly, I’ve always fought for common-sense solutions to save lives.

[_**Now, I need your help keeping up the fight as I run for Congress to represent California’s 40th District.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102980086/530880095/-757706824?refcode=BLU_EM_JKC_2025-02-28_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGUxN2RlOGItMmFmNi1lZjExLTkwY2ItMDAyMjQ4MmE5M2I1IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=TAwfP0PMzUJlm-x3Lsx3LXA9SCbIA3YBdfGKQBCDffg=)

In firefighting, when we pull up on a scene of a house on fire, we don’t ask who they voted for—we just put out the fire. As a fire captain and labor leader, I worked with both parties to protect rights and save lives. _It’s common sense._

**So, when I see Trump’s White House merely suggest seeking retribution for his political rivals instead of getting to work on the things he was elected to do, like lowering the costs of groceries and healthcare, I can’t sit back and let the fire spread.**

I will work with whomever, whenever, wherever, to fix our community’s greatest problems. This isn’t about being a Democrat or a Republican—hardworking families are being screwed over by chaos and gridlock in Washington. We need a practical problem solver who can understand both sides and bring people together with real solutions.

clean_body: We need a practical problem solver who can understand both sides and bring people together with real solutions. | = | Hi Peter, I’m Joe Kerr, a second-generation firefighter and labor leader. For three decades, I’ve run headfirst toward the problem—whether inside burning buildings or in the halls of the State Assembly, I’ve always fought for common-sense solutions to save lives. = | = In firefighting, when we pull up on a scene of a house on fire, we don’t ask who they voted for—we just put out the fire. As a fire captain and labor leader, I worked with both parties to protect rights and save lives. It’s common sense. So, when I see Trump’s White House merely suggest seeking retribution for his political rivals instead of getting to work on the things he was elected to do, like lowering the costs of groceries and healthcare, I can’t sit back and let the fire spread. I will work with whomever, whenever, wherever, to fix our community’s greatest problems. This isn’t about being a Democrat or a Republican—hardworking families are being screwed over by chaos and gridlock in Washington. We need a practical problem solver who can understand both sides and bring people together with real solutions. = | = | = | = | = | = Onward, Joe * | | = Paid for by Joe Kerr for California Joe Kerr for California 1400 N Harbor Blvd. Suite 550 Fullerton, CA 92835 United States | | | ---|---|--- = = If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please

name: Kimberly Bretches
subject: The George Floyd riots continue to haunt my husband
body:
| | | The same city that gave Chance this award is trying to put him in prison for life for doing his job.
---
| |
---
Dear Peter, That's me and my husband, Officer Chance Bretches in the picture I've sent you...
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=ffb4943a0aca45e6b97bc1b66da19bc6&_e=is-3IW68dtu4iKfC0_r0D9rc4TtAZogq1AhDasA_6eceRM3SANo3Sun2aymGxftdDtj92vucm480BHRN1yJnd54bGsz45AHieQzV5LVHqBi0ObNWftAQRVVG-HxGaH7wTAMw_hU_CRceUgfz6yExRihC9KpPk1hfzSY2ATYVXh5eHDJVx-ij1BkaB3VdWXBgKupOHTs6wvPnoaiMh0r-Jnpg8GbYTNZk5y1i_RxTWwp96m50IhBDVTeJQ4xsIpKHBoatCT5qEbO9iSFMesdc4pRYiyjiCVck9gR7LVOVcfOzBTBV7BTiC93XiHAQFt38rXCVHpFPn8-_m9Y9xS8tR_wbqgOvQabvAP5AIMT0VpwCGUp3TJBFJxlSK4uGRIavwSROY-kw9n6Xt3_BnHENhQ%3D%3D)
---
...a picture we took on the day Chance received the Lifesaving Medal With Valor for rescuing a driver from a crashed car that had caught on fire. This photo used to be one of my favorites. Now looking at it makes me cry. Because in July, the same city that gave Chance this award... ...will try to lock him up for life for doing his job. I should explain. For nearly 13 years, Chance has been a decorated police officer with the Austin, Texas Police Department. But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down. You probably remember what it was like in our country after George Floyd. Violent, fiery anti-police protests were sweeping through cities. Every step of the way, they were cheered on by radical politicians, Soros-funded prosecutors, and the Mainstream Media who lied to us and said, with a straight face, that these riots were "mostly peaceful." It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off. And my husband made it home safe and sound. What I didn’t know then was that this nightmare wasn't over for us. Far from it. Unknown to Chance and the other officers on duty that night, an anti-police protestor was hit by one of my husband's non-lethal rounds. They claimed they were injured and lost part of their finger. And for that... ...the county prosecutor charged my husband with "aggravated assault by a public servant" -- a charge punishable by life in prison. This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free... ...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters. What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-cop crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make cops pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. He's served on mission trips -- planting churches, planning vacation Bible schools, and sharing the Gospel. And he's done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record. Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars and could be his "reward." Even if my husband's good name is cleared there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills. Thankfully, by God's grace, there is one group who has stepped up to help us -- the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know that their record has made them a policemen's best friend. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. LELDF hires the best attorneys and secures expert witnesses who will testify to the truth -- without being influenced by political paybacks. And now they've agreed to help Chance. My friend, you've read my letter this far so I'm going to ask as boldly as I can: Will you help Chance, too? _**[Would you help by sending a one-time gift to LELDF so this amazing group can defend my husband and the other good police officers who have wrongly accused?](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=ffb4943a0aca45e6b97bc1b66da19bc6&_e=is-3IW68dtu4iKfC0_r0D9rc4TtAZogq1AhDasA_6eceRM3SANo3Sun2aymGxftdDtj92vucm480BHRN1yJnd54bGsz45AHieQzV5LVHqBi0ObNWftAQRVVG-HxGaH7wTAMw_hU_CRceUgfz6yExRihC9KpPk1hfzSY2ATYVXh5eHDJVx-ij1BkaB3VdWXBgKupOHTs6wvPnoaiMh0r-Jnpg8GbYTNZk5y1i_RxTWwo186xiX-qSSkf038PK3iaB3Y4k2bznv8GgZMCbwGT5OI-DHH6w94U0wPCrhWIJasppAMMnkD9Y_IKm4kzY00j8YmXcbMJ1tWR4BRrlC958upJcSTcg01XUGHvm4yx9Rv__zaHaTBtry8xV_p84LmwMfTXEcGYWTIWFvgZBa7tvDA%3D%3D)**_** ** You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. They rely entirely on the generosity of kind-hearted folks like you to defend the men and women in blue who defend us. _**[So with that in mind, please know that any contribution -- be it $35, $100, $500 or even $1,000 -- is tax-deductible.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=ffb4943a0aca45e6b97bc1b66da19bc6&_e=is-3IW68dtu4iKfC0_r0D9rc4TtAZogq1AhDasA_6eceRM3SANo3Sun2aymGxftdDtj92vucm480BHRN1yJnd54bGsz45AHieQzV5LVHqBi0ObNWftAQRVVG-HxGaH7wTAMw_hU_CRceUgfz6yExRihC9KpPk1hfzSY2ATYVXh5eHDJVx-ij1BkaB3VdWXBgKupOHTs6wvPnoaiMh0r-Jnpg8GbYTNZk5y1i_RxTWwqQbrpJz90TfGFVn9K3e2sSb1YMP8s2Xvm1PjyXpT8T0WMWPvBTC7KPJhx-5nZ_uu58CA8o8SxYC1cKmv0VurgnjZQzpfzXa7HKe65oMVxL4WgUUwrG3AHLIsArttVIVLtYFIbq1WIXb_IqTaRNr3iiV8vlrLM2NiaTeqWv5pYz2Q%3D%3D)**_ But whatever you feel led to give, please end it back quickly. Chance's trial starts on July 7th. Our legal team needs to be working day and night getting ready for his defense. Because if Chance is found guilty... ...he'll spend every wedding anniversary, birthday, and Christmas for the rest of his life in prison. He won't be able to take our sons to football games or teach them how to drive... He won't be able to walk our daughter down the aisle somebody... I can't bear the thought of life without him. And I know what happens to former police officers when they get locked up with thousands of criminals. My only hope of saving him today is good-hearted patriots like you. _**[So please, my friend, rush back your gift right away if possible.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=ffb4943a0aca45e6b97bc1b66da19bc6&_e=is-3IW68dtu4iKfC0_r0D9rc4TtAZogq1AhDasA_6eceRM3SANo3Sun2aymGxftdDtj92vucm480BHRN1yJnd54bGsz45AHieQzV5LVHqBi0ObNWftAQRVVG-HxGaH7wTAMw_hU_CRceUgfz6yExRihC9KpPk1hfzSY2ATYVXh5eHDJVx-ij1BkaB3VdWXBgKupOHTs6wvPnoaiMh0r-Jnpg8GbYTNZk5y1i_RxTWwqdMp4btgaxId_NQtNt_e-dcqYpPeyEFrH7B69P0wd6V5VDDmhadUPiKAx4m5Iojn3s49N1gz1aMEChxjSrmdsr7qUlZ2ORtwNqoQA4a_fzX-ANhs_3IISsJUdqZq47mPfAhdbVNT354yRXqhLyz4ToKh_dgy3GgbcOIVoZA9Y8sQ%3D%3D)**_ With this radical Soros-funded prosecutor on the warpath, _**[your gift of $35](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=ffb4943a0aca45e6b97bc1b66da19bc6&_e=is-3IW68dtu4iKfC0_r0D9rc4TtAZogq1AhDasA_6eceRM3SANo3Sun2aymGxftdDtj92vucm480BHRN1yJnd54bGsz45AHieQzV5LVHqBi0ObNWftAQRVVG-HxGaH7wTAMw_hU_CRceUgfz6yExRihC9KpPk1hfzSY2ATYVXh5eHDJVx-ij1BkaB3VdWXBgKupOHTs6wvPnoaiMh0r-Jnpg8GbYTNZk5y1i_RxTWwrer2Q8f6zBvn20UeR3morDW1NLqx1s_tEKhkTB-Ic6lqCH8HLeFW0aGTzrjFRKB-Q9dxH-Y4rCYENv546zBZjGjTXXayCkcOlsZmeG4urfD43XKnuEtFQcsOP6zNF7RzT2hfgpdmCkAnjid6Ym7kW6O2fQJfl4iN3_zwGYPWsVgQ%3D%3D)**_ \-- or any amount -- could be the difference between Chance clearing his good name... ...and spending the rest of his life behind bars. Thank you for reading my email today with such a generous spirit. I can never express how grateful I am to you -- in advance -- for helping my husband fight back.
---
With hope and thanks,
---
Kimberly Bretches
---
P.S. My husband Chance put his life on the line to keep our city safe from a rabid mob of violent protestors. Now life behind bars could be his "reward."And to make things worse, we're up against the deep pockets of a George Soros backed prosecutor in court. We have very little time to act before Chance's trial begins. Chance and I have three children -- and one more on the way. Please don't let them grow up without their father. _**[Thank you for any help you can send to LELDF today.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=ffb4943a0aca45e6b97bc1b66da19bc6&_e=is-3IW68dtu4iKfC0_r0D9rc4TtAZogq1AhDasA_6eceRM3SANo3Sun2aymGxftdDtj92vucm480BHRN1yJnd54bGsz45AHieQzV5LVHqBi0ObNWftAQRVVG-HxGaH7wTAMw_hU_CRceUgfz6yExRihC9KpPk1hfzSY2ATYVXh5eHDJVx-ij1BkaB3VdWXBgKupOHTs6wvPnoaiMh0r-Jnpg8GbYTNZk5y1i_RxTWwp9lUXONlQ-9Rw33wDZa7VC8QLnJGibGm-7XIj3qvnk1o4X-2CF0_R-8OhHHP-bMs9tXkLWaSuINv0AlWRy9Mwd_pGikMcX8naiFrrjDXZfuTRHAAFLRXtWE_XJxmrdHTLJDpvg02YM0QmlU03CuRNBb4U53R2JKcZL99RcNxj_iA%3D%3D)**_
---

Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars and could be his "reward." Even if my husband's good name is cleared there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills. Thankfully, by God's grace, there is one group who has stepped up to help us -- the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know that their record has made them a policemen's best friend. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. LELDF hires the best attorneys and secures expert witnesses who will testify to the truth -- without being influenced by political paybacks. And now they've agreed to help Chance. My friend, you've read my letter this far so I'm going to ask as boldly as I can: Will you help Chance, too? You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. They rely entirely on the generosity of kind-hearted folks like you to defend the men and women in blue who defend us. But whatever you feel led to give, please end it back quickly. Chance's trial starts on July 7th. Our legal team needs to be working day and night getting ready for his defense. Because if Chance is found guilty... ...he'll spend every wedding anniversary, birthday, and Christmas for the rest of his life in prison. He won't be able to take our sons to football games or teach them how to drive... He won't be able to walk our daughter down the aisle somebody... I can't bear the thought of life without him. And I know what happens to former police officers when they get locked up with thousands of criminals. My only hope of saving him today is good-hearted patriots like you. With this radical Soros-funded prosecutor on the warpath, \-- or any amount -- could be the difference between Chance clearing his good name... ...and spending the rest of his life behind bars. Thank you for reading my email today with such a generous spirit. I can never express how grateful I am to you -- in advance -- for helping my husband fight back. With hope and thanks, Kimberly Bretches P.S. My husband Chance put his life on the line to keep our city safe from a rabid mob of violent protestors. Now life behind bars could be his "reward."And to make things worse, we're up against the deep pockets of a George Soros backed prosecutor in court. We have very little time to act before Chance's trial begins. Chance and I have three children -- and one more on the way. Please don't let them grow up without their father. | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit. And remember –Blue Lives Matter! © Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | 2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303

Donald Trump and his allies are recklessly cutting essential programs Coloradans rely on — all to hand more tax breaks to billionaires and big corporations.

Just this week, 217 House Republicans voted to rip away health care from the American people and gut Medicaid.

This isn’t just wrong — it’s not what the American people voted for.

A recent poll shows that 71% of Trump voters oppose Medicaid cuts. But Donald Trump and his Republican cronies don’t care about the voters who put them in power.

Their priority? Lining their own pockets and the pockets of their wealthy allies and backers.

I ran for Congress because I was tired of politicians putting their special interest donors ahead of the people they’re supposed to serve. If there’s ever been a time to put country over party, it’s right now.

Families don’t care about partisan games and political stunts. They care about affording groceries, keeping their kids safe at school, and making ends meet. That’s why I’m fighting to lower costs, create well-paying jobs, and defend our fundamental freedoms.

But Trump and his allies are working hard to roll back our progress. They’re putting democracy at risk at home and abroad. They’re lining their own pockets all while Americans are struggling to afford basic necessities like eggs and gas.

We have to hold them accountable.

clean_body: Jason Crow For Congress [] Team, what’s happening in Washington right now is unacceptable. Donald Trump and his allies are recklessly cutting essential programs Coloradans rely on — all to hand more tax breaks to billionaires and big corporations. Just this week, 217 House Republicans voted to rip away health care from the American people and gut Medicaid. This isn’t just wrong — it’s not what the American people voted for. A recent poll shows that 71% of Trump voters oppose Medicaid cuts. But Donald Trump and his Republican cronies don’t care about the voters who put them in power. Their priority? Lining their own pockets and the pockets of their wealthy allies and backers. I ran for Congress because I was tired of politicians putting their special interest donors ahead of the people they’re supposed to serve. If there’s ever been a time to put country over party, it’s right now. Families don’t care about partisan games and political stunts. They care about affording groceries, keeping their kids safe at school, and making ends meet. That’s why I’m fighting to lower costs, create well-paying jobs, and defend our fundamental freedoms. But Trump and his allies are working hard to roll back our progress. They’re putting democracy at risk at home and abroad. They’re lining their own pockets all while Americans are struggling to afford basic necessities like eggs and gas. We have to hold them accountable. Our end of month deadline is tomorrow, and this is our chance to fight back. If you’re with me, please chip in now to power our campaign and help me fight for Colorado values in Congress. President Donald J. Trump announced Thursday that U.S. Senator Katie Britt, R-Ala., will lead a Presidential Delegation to Montevideo, Uruguay, to attend the inauguration of President-elect Yamandú Orsi.

“On behalf of President Trump and our nation, I am excited to be leading the United States’ delegation to Uruguay’s presidential inauguration,” said Senator Britt. “It was a very humbling moment to be selected by President Trump to lead this presidential delegation, and I am honored he has entrusted me with the responsibility to do this.”

U.S. Sen. Katie Britt recently participated in a hearing of the Senate Committee on the Judiciary on Todd Blanche's nomination to serve as deputy Attorney General and Gail Slater's nomination to serve as assistant attorney general for the Antitrust Division.

In the hearing, Britt asked Blanche about the Executive Office for Immigration Review. She highlighted the court's backlog, which grew from 1.4 million in fiscal year 2021, Joe Biden's first year as president, to 3.5 million in fiscal year 2024, his final year.

U.S. Senators Tommy Tuberville and Katie Britt, along with U.S. Senator Rand Paul (R-KY) have reintroduced legislation that repeals six controversial statutory provisions in two existing labor-related laws.
The laws that the National Right to Work Act will alter if ratified include the National Labor Relations Act and the Railway Labor Act. Both allow private-sector workers, airline, and railroad employees, to be terminated if they don’t surrender a portion of their paycheck to a union.

Release Date: February 28, 2025
PRESS RELEASE:
Portland, OR – On Saturday, February 22nd in Portland, delegates from around the state gathered to elect a new leadership team of the Oregon Republican Party. New officers—Chair **Jerry Cummings,** Vice Chair **Connie Whelchel,** Secretary **Sheri Brady,** and Treasurer **Glenn Miller** —plan to usher in a new era focused on uniting the party, strengthening party infrastructure, expanding voter outreach, advocating for election security, and raising the necessary funds to secure Republican victories in key statewide races. A lifelong Republican, **Jerry Cummings** brings to the new role decades of leadership experience in politics, business, and community service. In addition to serving in numerous GOP leadership positions in the Pacific Northwest, his background as a Baptist minister, small business owner, and media professional equips him with the necessary skills to unite and energize the party. His strategic vision emphasizes collaboration, innovative fundraising, building a well-trained volunteer base, engaging key voter groups—including non-affiliated voters—and ensuring Republicans regain a legislative majority by 2030 to shape a common-sense future for Oregon. The top ORP Delegate to the Republican National Convention, newly elected Vice Chair **Connie Whelchel** brings a strong background in business operations, communications, and political organizing. A leader in the Deschutes County Republican Party, Whelchel played a key role in record-breaking fundraising and voter outreach initiatives. As ORP’s former Get Out the Vote (GOTV) Committee Chair, Whelchel developed training programs and engagement strategies that led the party to register 1.5 times more new Republican voters than any other political party, as well as to mobilize 87.8% of Republican voters to the polls in November, a greater percentage than any other party. Whelchel is committed to advancing election reform, evolving GOTV tools and resources, and fostering party unity. Newly-elected Secretary **Sheri Brady,** a dedicated Republican with experience in grassroots organizing, party administration, and election strategy, served in leadership of the Douglas County Republican Central Committee, where she led voter registration drives, GOTV efforts, and election integrity initiatives, as well as played a key role in Republican campaigns. Brady was a Delegate to the 2024 Republican National Convention, serving as Whip in the RNC Rules Committee. An Army Reserve National Guard veteran with a background in office administration and graphic design, Brady brings discipline, organization, and strong communication skills to the role. As Secretary of the ORP, she will focus on transparency, efficiency, and collaboration to grow the party from the ground up and to elect Republicans across Oregon. New ORP Treasurer **Glenn Miller** is an experienced IT professional, business analyst, financial steward, and dedicated public servant who has served as Treasurer for multiple political and nonprofit organizations. As Treasurer of the Washington County Republican Party, he implemented a long-term financial strategy, introduced funds-based accounting, and improved budget transparency. Miller also brings valuable leadership experience from his tenure as Vice Chair of the Hillsboro School Board, where he advocated for parental rights and played a key role in a $15 million cost-saving boundary change. He will ensure that ORP operates with financial integrity and is well-positioned to support Republican candidates across Oregon. **With Oregon consistently ranking at the bottom nationally in handling education, homelessness, public safety, and economic opportunity, the new ORP leadership team is committed to engaging with and uniting Oregonians to elect common** -sense Republican leaders who will restore balance to the state through policies that put families and communities first. With renewed vision and a commitment to victory—especially with President Donald Trump and a Republican Congress leading in D.C.—the Oregon Republican Party is prepared to champion a brighter future for all Oregonians. ####

body:
After that horrendous display in the Oval Office today, Putin and his cronies in Russia are popping champagne, America is weaker on the world stage, and we are all less safe.
#

Team, it’s Mark Kelly.
It might seem like everything is spinning out of control right now, but the truth continues to be the truth. Here’s a reality check:
Russia invaded Ukraine, and Putin is a dictator. That’s the truth.
President Zelenskyy is defending his people, and Putin is targeting and killing them in schools and hospitals. That’s the truth.
Ukraine is fighting for their right to freedom and democracy, and Russia is fighting to reclaim the empire they lost when the Soviet Union fell. That’s the truth.
And, after that horrendous display in the Oval Office today, Putin and his cronies in Russia are popping champagne, America is weaker on the world stage, and we are all less safe.
**That is the truth.**
I’ve been to Ukraine. I’ve met with President Zelenskyy many times, including earlier today. Ukrainian pilots have trained on the F-16 in my state. I’ve hosted those pilots in my office. One of the pilots I met was killed in action, defending his country.
Everyone wants to see this conflict end, including me. But the kind of peace that emerges matters, and it’s essential that it leaves Ukraine in a position of security and that the aggressor — Putin — pays a price for his crimes. After today, it feels like we’ve almost fully switched sides. It’s incredibly disappointing, but it’s not over.
I am going to continue pushing help to the Ukrainians. I am going to continue to press the Trump Administration, including Secretary Rubio and National Security Advisor Waltz, to get back in the room and work this out. And I’m going to need you to continue to speak out about this, and be public and vocal in your support for Ukraine. It’s not only essential to their future, but to our own national security.
A free, unoccupied, and democratic Ukraine not under constant threat from Putin will make all of us safer, and each of us needs to do whatever we can to help them win this war.
Thank you, really, for reading.
Mark
